verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs say it aggregates occurrences of the same error into Items using a default grouping algorithm. When that algorithm splits or combines occurrences wrongly, users can set Custom Fingerprinting Rules or merge items manually, which covers both the grouping and the correction parts of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the default algorithm fingerprints on stack traces, and independent or hands-on corroboration of grouping accuracy at scale.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform groups thousands of duplicate events into one issue via stack-trace fingerprinting, and I can customize the grouping when it gets it wrong

citations.quote: Rollbar aggregates _Occurrences_ caused by the same error into _Items_ that represent application issues.
If our default grouping algorithm is separating occurrences that you would rather have combined or vice versa, then you can set up Custom Fingerprinting Rules.
Item merging allows you to combine multiple items into one 'group' for easier management and more accurate metrics.
